properties.name: gitvault.environment
properties.description: Vault environment to load, e.g. production. Defaults to GITVAULT_ENV, then the single active Spring profile.

properties.name: gitvault.vault
properties.description: Vault id. Defaults to GITVAULT_VAULT, then the vault chosen with 'gitvault vault use'.

properties.name: gitvault.bin
properties.description: Path of the gitvault binary. Defaults to GITVAULT_BIN, then 'gitvault' on PATH.

properties.name: gitvault.override
properties.description: Let vault values win over OS environment variables.

properties.name: gitvault.fail-fast
properties.description: Fail the startup when the secrets cannot be loaded (locked vault, CLI missing, ...).

properties.name: gitvault.timeout-seconds
properties.description: How long to wait for the gitvault CLI.
